turns.speaker: dad
turns.text: Are you trying to power a small city in my basement?!

turns.speaker: junior
turns.text: Dad, it's just my local LLM fine-tuning. Gotta get those 70B models right!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.text: 70 BILLION PARAMETERS?! My electric meter is spinning faster than your GPU fan! Look at this bill!

turns.speaker: junior
turns.text: Whoa, that's... a lot of kilowatts. But think of the inference latency, Dad!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.text: Inference latency? Back in my day, we optimized code by turning off the lights and walking uphill both ways!

turns.speaker: junior
turns.text: Alright, fine. I'll cap training to 30B during peak hours. Happy now?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.text: Much better. And try turning off that monitor when you're not actively debugging. Every electron counts!

hookSubheadline: Dad's electric meter trauma meets Junior's GPU farm.

cardData.line3: Equivalent to powering a small village
